weather_report:
Late morning in Subiaco arrives under a soft scatter of cloud, the sun slipping between bright and pale, the air clear and easy on the eyes. Expect this pattern to hold into early afternoon: mostly sunny with roaming patches of shade. Visibility looks crisp, colors a touch saturated, and the UV will climb fast toward midday despite the gauzy cover, so a hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen will earn their keep.

It reads as a pleasant, open-skied day—enough light to feel alive without the harshness. Dress in light, breathable layers with comfortable shoes; carry a light outer layer if you’re ducking between cool interiors and warm pavements. Good weather for simple errands done on foot, a slow coffee at a shaded table, leafing through a book on a balcony, or a modest loop through the neighborhood to stretch the legs and see what spring is doing to the trees.
